summary: Reconcile the two G03 governance explanations with the current six-protocol catalog and distinguish current readiness from the historical Phase 9 report.
rationale: Both governance documents still contain four-protocol and all-Proposed prose from the earlier Phase 9 baseline, while the current catalog has six protocols, four Active and two Proposed, and all 46 legacy public surfaces are Retired. C2d may correct explanatory text and add a catalog-reconciled current protocol table without changing catalog authority, recorded historical evidence, protocol lifecycle, approval checkboxes or production Profile. This implementation decision is not a multi-owner G03 closure approval.
